title: SignSplit, which offers infrastructure to let people digitally sign datasets, likenesses, and creative works, raised $400M from W Group at a $1B valuation (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Mike Wheatley / SiliconANGLE: SignSplit, which offers infrastructure to let people digitally sign datasets, likenesses, and creative works, raised $400M from W Group at a $1B valuation — Few technology companies can help users to protect and monetize their personal data for artificial intelligence as well as SignSplit PBC, it seems.
